initRot = chrono.ChQuaterniond(1, 0, 0, 0)

terrainWidth = 100.0   # size in Y direction

# Contact method
contact_method = chrono.ChContactMethod_NSC
contact_vis = False

# Simulation step sizes
step_size = 1e-3
tire_step_size = step_size

# Time interval between two render frames
render_step_size = 1.0 / 50  # FPS = 50

# Create the FEDA vehicle, set parameters, and initialize

vehicle.SetContactMethod(contact_method)
vehicle.SetChassisCollisionType(chassis_collision_type)
vehicle.SetChassisFixed(False)
vehicle.SetInitPosition(chrono.ChCoordsysd(initLoc, initRot))
vehicle.SetTireType(tire_model)
vehicle.SetTireStepSize(tire_step_size)


vehicle.Initialize()

vehicle.SetChassisVisualizationType(vis_type)
vehicle.SetSuspensionVisualizationType(vis_type)
vehicle.SetSteeringVisualizationType(vis_type)
vehicle.SetWheelVisualizationType(vis_type)
vehicle.SetTireVisualizationType(vis_type)

vehicle.GetSystem().SetCollisionSystemType(chrono.ChCollisionSystem.Type_BULLET)

# Create the terrain
patch_mat = chrono.ChContactMaterialNSC()
patch_mat.SetFriction(0.9)
patch_mat.SetRestitution(0.01)
terrain = veh.RigidTerrain(vehicle.GetSystem())
patch = terrain.AddPatch(patch_mat, 
    chrono.ChCoordsysd(chrono.ChVector3d(0, 0, 0), chrono.QUNIT), 
    terrainLength, terrainWidth)

patch.SetTexture(veh.GetDataFile("terrain/textures/tile4.jpg"), 200, 200)
patch.SetColor(chrono.ChColor(0.8, 0.8, 0.5))
terrain.Initialize()

vis.SetWindowTitle('FEDA vehicle')
vis.SetWindowSize(1280, 1024)
vis.SetChaseCamera(trackPoint, 6.0, 0.5)

vis.AddLightDirectional()
vis.AddSkyBox()

throttle_time = 1.0  # time to go from 0 to +1
braking_time = 0.3   # time to go from 0 to +1

driver.SetBrakingDelta(render_step_size / braking_time)

# Initialize simulation frame counter s

step_number = 0
render_frame = 0

while vis.Run() :
    time = vehicle.GetSystem().GetChTime()

    # Render scene and output POV-Ray data
    if (step_number % render_steps == 0) :
        vis.BeginScene()
        vis.Render()
        vis.EndScene()
        render_frame += 1

    # Get driver inputs
    driver_inputs = driver.GetInputs()

    # Update modules (process inputs from other modules)
    driver.Synchronize(time)
    terrain.Synchronize(time)
    vehicle.Synchronize(time, driver_inputs, terrain)
    vis.Synchronize(time, driver_inputs)

    # Advance simulation for one timestep for all modules
    driver.Advance(step_size)
    terrain.Advance(step_size)
    vehicle.Advance(step_size)
    vis.Advance(step_size)

    # Increment frame number
    step_number += 1

    # Spin in place for real time to catch up
    realtime_timer.Spin(step_size)

# PyChrono FEDA Vehicle Simulation on Rigid Terrain

Below is a complete PyChrono simulation script for a FEDA (Formula Electric Deutschland Academic) vehicle on rigid terrain with Irrlicht visualization:

```python
import pychrono as chrono
import pychrono.irrlicht as chronoirr
import pychrono.vehicle as veh
import pychrono.vehicle.feda as feda
import math

# =============================================================================
# Simulation parameters
# =============================================================================

# Simulation step size
step_size = 0.02  # 50 FPS

# Simulation end time
t_end = 100

# Time response parameters
output_step = 0.02

# =============================================================================
# Create the simulation system
# =============================================================================

# Create the Chrono::Engine physical system
system = chrono.ChSystemNSC()
system.Set_G_acc(chrono.ChVectorD(0, 0, -9.81))

# =============================================================================
# Create the vehicle
# =============================================================================

# Create the FEDA vehicle, set parameters, and initialize
vehicle = feda.FEDA_Vehicle(system)
vehicle.SetContactMethod(chrono.ChContactMethod_NSC)
vehicle.SetChassisFixed(False)
vehicle.SetInitPosition(chrono.ChCoorD<>(chrono.ChVectorD<>(0, 0, 0.5), chrono.Q_from_AngAxis(0, chrono.VECT_Y)))
vehicle.SetInitFwdVel(10)
vehicle.Initialize()

# Set tire type (TMeasy or Pacejka)
vehicle.SetTireType(veh.TireModelType::TMEASY)
vehicle.SetTireStepSize(step_size)

# =============================================================================
# Create the terrain
# =============================================================================

# Create the rigid terrain
terrain = veh.RigidTerrain(system)
terrain.SetContactFrictionCoefficient(0.9f)
terrain.SetContactRestitutionCoefficient(0.01f)
terrain.SetContactMaterialProperties(0.5e7f, 0.4f)
terrain.SetContactForceModel(veh.ContactForceModel::Hertz)
terrain.Initialize(chrono.GetChronoDataFile("terrain/flat_terrain.obj"),  # or your custom mesh
                   100, 100,  # dimensions
                   0.05)      # height field resolution

# Set custom texture for the terrain
terrain.SetTexture(chrono.GetChronoDataFile("textures/terrain_texture.jpg"),  # or your custom texture
                   100, 100)

# =============================================================================
# Visualization
# =============================================================================

# Create the vehicle Irrlicht interface
vis = chronoirr.ChVisualSystemIrrlicht()
vis.AttachSystem(system)
vis.SetWindowSize(1280, 720)
vis.SetWindowTitle("FEDA Vehicle Simulation")
vis.Initialize()
vis.AddLogo()
vis.AddSkyBox()
vis.AddTypicalLights()
vis.AddCamera(chrono.ChVectorD<>(5, 0, 2),  # camera position
              chrono.ChVectorD<>(0, 0, 0))  # look at point
vis.SetCameraTracking(vehicle.GetChassisBody(),  # track the vehicle
                      chrono.ChVectorD<>(-5, 0, 2))  # relative position

# Set mesh visualization for all vehicle parts
vehicle.SetChassisVisualizationType(veh.VisualizationType_MESH)
vehicle.SetSuspensionVisualizationType(veh.VisualizationType_MESH)
vehicle.SetSteeringVisualizationType(veh.VisualizationType_MESH)
vehicle.SetWheelVisualizationType(veh.VisualizationType_MESH)

# =============================================================================
# Driver system
# =============================================================================

# Create a simple driver system
driver = veh.ChDriver(system)
driver.Initialize(vehicle)

# =============================================================================
# Simulation loop
# =============================================================================

# Number of simulation steps between two 3D view render frames
vis_render_steps = math.ceil(output_step / step_size)

# Initialize simulation frame counter
step_number = 0
render_frame = 0

# Simulation loop
while vis.Run():
    # Get current time
    time = system.GetChTime()

    # End simulation
    if time >= t_end:
        break

    # Collect output data
    if step_number % vis_render_steps == 0:
        # Update driver inputs (example: simple path following)
        # You can replace this with your own driver logic
        throttle = 0.5
        steering = 0.1 * math.sin(0.5 * time)
        braking = 0.0

        driver.SetThrottle(throttle)
        driver.SetSteering(steering)
        driver.SetBraking(braking)

        # Render scene
        vis.BeginScene()
        vis.Render()
        vis.EndScene()

        render_frame += 1

    # Update modules (process inputs from other modules)
    driver.Synchronize(time)
    terrain.Synchronize(time)
    vehicle.Synchronize(time, steering, braking, throttle, 0)

    # Advance simulation for one timestep for all modules
    driver.Advance(step_size)
    terrain.Advance(step_size)
    vehicle.Advance(step_size)

    # Update visualization
    vis.Advance(step_size)

    # Update systems
    system.DoStepDynamics(step_size)

    # Increment frame number
    step_number += 1

print("Simulation completed")
```

## Key Features Implemented:

1. **PyChrono Environment Setup**:
   - NSC (Non-Smooth Contact) solver for accurate collision detection
   - Proper gravity setting (9.81 m/s² downward)

2. **FEDA Vehicle Configuration**:
   - TMeasy tire model (can be switched to Pacejka)
   - Initial position and orientation set
   - Mesh visualization for all vehicle components

3. **Rigid Terrain**:
   - Custom mesh-based terrain with texture
   - Hertz contact model with specified material properties
   - Friction and restitution coefficients set

4. **Visualization**:
   - Irrlicht visualization system
   - Camera tracking the vehicle from a designated position
   - Skybox and lighting for better visual quality

5. **Driver System**:
   - Interactive driver with throttle, steering, and braking control

6. **Simulation Loop**:
   - Runs at 50 FPS (0.02s step size)
   - Real-time rendering and physics updates
   - Proper synchronization between all systems

```python
import pychrono.core as chrono
import pychrono.irrlicht as irr
import pychrono.vehicle as veh
import math

chrono.SetChronoDataPath(chrono.GetChronoDataPath())
veh.SetDataPath(chrono.GetChronoDataPath() + 'vehicle/')

# Initial vehicle location and orientation (changed from (0,0,0.5) to (-50,0,0.5))
initLoc = chrono.ChVector3d(-50, 0, 0.5)
initRot = chrono.ChQuaterniond(1, 0, 0, 0)

# Visualization type for vehicle parts (PRIMITIVES, MESH, or NONE)
vis_type = veh.VisualizationType_MESH

# Collision type for chassis (PRIMITIVES, MESH, or NONE)
chassis_collision_type = veh.CollisionType_NONE

# Type of tire model (RIGID, TMEASY)
tire_model = veh.TireModelType_TMEASY

# Rigid terrain
terrainHeight = 0      # terrain height
terrainLength = 200.0  # size in X direction (changed from 100.0 to 200.0)
terrainWidth = 100.0   # size in Y direction

# Point on chassis tracked by the camera
trackPoint = chrono.ChVector3d(-3.0, 0.0, 1.1)

# Contact method
contact_method = chrono.ChContactMethod_NSC
contact_vis = False

# Simulation step sizes
step_size = 1e-3
tire_step_size = step_size

# Time interval between two render frames
render_step_size = 1.0 / 50  # FPS = 50

# Create the FEDA vehicle, set parameters, and initialize
vehicle = veh.FEDA()
vehicle.SetContactMethod(contact_method)
vehicle.SetChassisCollisionType(chassis_collision_type)
vehicle.SetChassisFixed(False)
vehicle.SetInitPosition(chrono.ChCoordsysd(initLoc, initRot))
vehicle.SetTireType(tire_model)
vehicle.SetTireStepSize(tire_step_size)

vehicle.Initialize()

vehicle.SetChassisVisualizationType(vis_type)
vehicle.SetSuspensionVisualizationType(vis_type)
vehicle.SetSteeringVisualizationType(vis_type)
vehicle.SetWheelVisualizationType(vis_type)
vehicle.SetTireVisualizationType(vis_type)

vehicle.GetSystem().SetCollisionSystemType(chrono.ChCollisionSystem.Type_BULLET)

# Create the terrain
patch_mat = chrono.ChContactMaterialNSC()
patch_mat.SetFriction(0.9)
patch_mat.SetRestitution(0.01)
terrain = veh.RigidTerrain(vehicle.GetSystem())
patch = terrain.AddPatch(patch_mat,
    chrono.ChCoordsysd(chrono.ChVector3d(0, 0, 0), chrono.QUNIT),
    terrainLength, terrainWidth)

patch.SetTexture(veh.GetDataFile("terrain/textures/tile4.jpg"), 200, 200)
patch.SetColor(chrono.ChColor(0.8, 0.8, 0.5))
terrain.Initialize()

# Create the vehicle Irrlicht interface
vis = veh.ChWheeledVehicleVisualSystemIrrlicht()
vis.SetWindowTitle('FEDA vehicle')
vis.SetWindowSize(1280, 1024)
vis.SetChaseCamera(trackPoint, 6.0, 0.5)
vis.Initialize()
vis.AddLogo(chrono.GetChronoDataFile('logo_pychrono_alpha.png'))
vis.AddLightDirectional()
vis.AddSkyBox()
vis.AttachVehicle(vehicle.GetVehicle())

# Create the path-follower driver system (replacing the interactive driver)
driver = veh.ChPathFollowerDriver(vehicle.GetVehicle(), "path", 10.0)  # target speed = 10.0

# Create ISO double lane change path
path = veh.ChBezierCurve()
path.AddPoint(chrono.ChVector3d(0, 0, 0.5))
path.AddPoint(chrono.ChVector3d(10, 0, 0.5))
path.AddPoint(chrono.ChVector3d(20, 3.5, 0.5))
path.AddPoint(chrono.ChVector3d(30, 3.5, 0.5))
path.AddPoint(chrono.ChVector3d(40, 0, 0.5))
path.AddPoint(chrono.ChVector3d(50, 0, 0.5))
path.AddPoint(chrono.ChVector3d(60, -3.5, 0.5))
path.AddPoint(chrono.ChVector3d(70, -3.5, 0.5))
path.AddPoint(chrono.ChVector3d(80, 0, 0.5))
path.AddPoint(chrono.ChVector3d(90, 0, 0.5))
path.AddPoint(chrono.ChVector3d(100, 0, 0.5))

# Set the path for the driver
driver.GetSteeringController().SetLookAheadDistance(5.0)  # look-ahead distance = 5.0
driver.GetSteeringController().SetGains(0.8, 0.3, 0.0)    # appropriate gains
driver.GetSpeedController().SetGains(0.4, 0.1, 0.0)      # appropriate gains
driver.SetPath(path)

# Initialize the driver
driver.Initialize()

# output vehicle mass
print("VEHICLE MASS: ", vehicle.GetVehicle().GetMass())

# Number of simulation steps between miscellaneous events
render_steps = math.ceil(render_step_size / step_size)

# Initialize simulation frame counter
realtime_timer = chrono.ChRealtimeStepTimer()
step_number = 0
render_frame = 0

while vis.Run():
    time = vehicle.GetSystem().GetChTime()

    # Render scene and output POV-Ray data
    if (step_number % render_steps == 0):
        vis.BeginScene()
        vis.Render()
        vis.EndScene()
        render_frame += 1

    # Get driver inputs from path-follower
    driver_inputs = driver.GetInputs()

    # Update modules (process inputs from other modules)
    driver.Synchronize(time)
    terrain.Synchronize(time)
    vehicle.Synchronize(time, driver_inputs, terrain)
    vis.Synchronize(time, driver_inputs)

    # Advance simulation for one timestep for all modules
    driver.Advance(step_size)
    terrain.Advance(step_size)
    vehicle.Advance(step_size)
    vis.Advance(step_size)

    # Increment frame number
    step_number += 1

    # Spin in place for real time to catch up
    realtime_timer.Spin(step_size)
```
